slides.headline: Florida gas hit $4.22 a gallon this week
slides.body: Florida regular gas averaged $4.22 for the week of Sept. 21, up from $4.10 one week earlier.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Florida gas station fuel pump
photo.prompt: gas pump handle at a Florida station with regular fuel price digits visible and traffic behind it

slides.headline: That's 12 cents more than last week
slides.body: The state average was $3.86 two weeks earlier and $3.77 one month earlier.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons gasoline pump close up
photo.prompt: close-up of a driver filling a car at a gas pump in South Florida daylight

slides.headline: That also means gas is up $1.26 from last year
slides.body: Florida regular gas averaged $2.96 a year earlier. A 15-gallon fill-up now costs $18.90 more than it did then.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons car fueling gasoline station
photo.prompt: person fueling a car at a roadside gas station with palm trees in the distance

slides.headline: Which puts Florida near its 12-month high
slides.body: The highest Florida average in the last 12 months was $4.30 in the week of May 11. The lowest was $2.60 in January.

photo.prompt: busy Florida highway traffic passing gas station signs under a bright sky

slides.headline: Crude costs and Mideast conflict are in the mix
slides.body: Florida outlets tied the latest spike to rising crude oil costs and continuing Mideast conflict.

photo.prompt: oil refinery equipment and fuel storage tanks under an overcast sky

slides.headline: And diesel hit $6.34 in Florida
slides.body: Diesel reached $6.34 a gallon in Florida, raising concerns about higher costs for goods and services.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons diesel fuel pump truck
photo.prompt: diesel pump beside a delivery truck at a Florida fueling station

slides.headline: So drivers are waiting for relief
slides.body: Florida's average remains 8 cents below its 12-month high of $4.30.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Miami traffic cars highway
photo.prompt: cars lined up in Miami traffic near a gas station during the afternoon
